_real_world.role: Ramjet-powered anti-ship missile shown on J-15/J-15T
_real_world.public_debut: 3 Sep 2025 Victory Day parade, alongside YJ-17/YJ-19/YJ-20 (csg-cn-yj20-gt-2025, B). Official media collective statement: YJ-15/17/19/20 'can be carried by carrier-based fighter jets, surface vessels and submarines' (not per-missile confirmation)
_real_world.carrier_fighter_carriage: J-15/J-15T photographed with 2x YJ-15 (Feb 2026, unofficial image); SCMP cannot verify image authenticity (csg-cn-yj12-usni-2026, csg-cn-yj15-scmp, B)
_real_world.range_km: LARGE CONFLICT: 1,200-1,800 km (Janes analysis for 'new air-launched anti-ship missiles' via USNI, B -- wording may refer to the missile class generally, not YJ-15 specifically) / '>1,000' km (USNI headline, B) / ~500 km (Military Watch Magazine, C). Physical-size sanity check (compact fighter-carried ramjet, ~1,100kg class) argues strongly for the lower end; the OOB doc itself gives an engineering_estimate of 400-800 km pending better data
_real_world.propulsion: Ramjet (consistent with the YJ-12/YJ-15 family naming convention and parade unveiling alongside other ramjet/scramjet-family rounds)
_real_world.status: content_only_no_mechanism (air-launch spawns a generic missile per authoring_standard; no functional NavalWeaponType anti-ship mount exists yet in the engine mechanism set)
